### HOW TO DRAFT A RESEARCH PROPOSAL: 31.08.2017
We, the department of Civil Engineering of ABMSP’s APCOER have organized a one day workshop on “How to Draft a Research Proposal” with an aim to inculcate the research activity amongst the young researchers and to avail the windows of funding’s, by drafting a good research proposal. This workshop was organized for the faculties from science & technology and research scholars. We have got numbers of entries for this workshop from different colleges affiliated to SPPU & other than SPPU, who were fortunate to have a chance to listen to & interact with the eminent speakers invited for this workshop.
